caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a sculpted figure of a bird with an elongated neck, perched upright on a rounded pedestal base. The entire object appears to be made of a brown material, likely wood, with textured, cross-hatched patterns carved along the bird's body, wings, and neck to suggest feathers. The bird has a small crest on its head, a hooked beak, and its feet are wrapped around the top of the cylindrical pedestal. The pedestal itself is also intricately carved and rests on a circular platform, with layered bands and a stone-like texture at the base. The background is plain and off-white with some minor discolorations and faint marks, and there are no additional objects or features surrounding the bird sculpture.
title: Pa. German Eaglet
